prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide responsive homepage banner background for Boşa Gezme!, a Turkish social-discovery product for physical home and living stores
Primary request: Create an editorial, photorealistic scene inside a welcoming independent home-and-living store in Turkey, conveying the beginning of a real shopping trip and the act of discovering a place worth visiting.
Scene/backdrop: layered store interior with home textiles, curtains, warm lamps, ceramics and a restrained furniture vignette; clearly a real physical shop, not an ecommerce studio or luxury showroom.
Subject: one shopper seen naturally from behind or at a distance, browsing and touching a textile; no identifiable face.
Style/medium: premium natural-light editorial photography with realistic materials and human-scale imperfections.
Composition/framing: cinematic wide 16:9 landscape; reserve a calm, darker, low-detail area across the left 45% for accessible HTML copy, with the shopper and strongest store details on the right; crop-safe for desktop and mobile.
Lighting/mood: warm daylight entering from a shop window, confident, approachable, calm.
Color palette: warm off-white, honey, muted clay, natural wood, charcoal shadows, consistent with Boşa Gezme!'s Daylight design system.
Materials/textures: linen, cotton, ceramic, wood, woven rug, brushed metal lamp.
Constraints: background image only; no embedded typography; no text; no logos; no brand marks; no fake UI; no watermark; no floating objects; no generic online-shopping imagery; retain enough dark tonal contrast on the left for white overlay text.
